Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That’s it from the coverage of this game and the Test series as well. But the visitors will not fly back home yet as India and South Africa will battle against each other in a three-match ODI series. The first ODI is scheduled to be played on 19th January, 2022 at 1400 IST (0830 GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Keegan Petersen is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH and the PLAYER OF THE SERIES. He says that it will take a couple of hours to sink in, but he is feeling happy and emotional. Adds that he took every little positive from each innings he played. It has been a tough journey for him, it has been difficult in different conditions. He says that, It's not been easy coming to Test cricket, there have been challenging wickets to play on, so it has been tough. Mentions that they knew it was always going to be difficult against top bowling attack, but they had a tough mindset. Concludes by saying that he has enjoyed every bit of his innings.

Dean Elgar, the victorious skipper, is in for a chat. He says that they are pretty elated. Mentions that he couldn't be more proud of the group and the guys have responded exceedingly well after the first loss. Tells that one needs to show immense character in these kind of conditions and 60 wickets in three Tests is a tough challenge for the bowlers but they bowled really well and it was unreal to see some performances. Says that he is extremely proud of the team. Adds that it helps to have a group that really doesn't have any big names, the guys just played well and played as a team. Mentions that he laid a few challenges, even to some senior players but it was great to see them take the message and be on board. Says that they have played as a unit and they have grown massively as a group in the last two Tests. States that if one needs to be No.1 someday in Test cricket, one needs to beat the best in the world. Says he is really happy with how things panned out in the end. Also says that they are by no means like a finished article and he is already focusing on the next series. Informs that there are still a few negatives that they need to work on. On Keegan Petersen, he says that he responded really well after the first Test and has shown great character. Also says that he has been brilliant in the domestic circuit for a while now and it's great to see him do so well in these last two Tests. Ends by saying that he's willing to learn more and more and a team needs a player like that who shows great character.

Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper, is in for a chat. He says, that he thinks it's a great spectacle of Test cricket for everyone. It was a hard-fought series. But South Africa have done well. They were able to capitalize on important hours and were absolutely the deserving winners at the end. Adds that one of the challenges faced during tours are to capitalize on momentum when it is on their side. Whenever they have done that, they have won games. But when they haven't done so, they have lost matches. Mentions that batting was the issue for their side, and South Africans have done well with the ball in these conditions, and yes, batting collapse is an issue and they will work upon that. On being asked what were the things he was happy about, he says that KL Rahul and Mayank Agarwal batted well, Pant's century was special and the win at centurion was special too.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

But once again, Jansen and Rabada ran riot with the ball and sent back the opening pair cheaply at the end of Day 2. India would've loved to put up a target of 300 runs, but on the moving day, India lost two wickets within the opening 10 minutes of the morning session, in the form of Pujara and Rahane. It was Pant who played an aggressive innings but not relentless to notch-up his first Test ton against South Africa and set up a target just over 200 runs. India though managed to get a couple of wickets in the final session of Day 3. There were some decisions that the Indians were not happy with and due to lapse of concentration at certain phases might've costed them this series.

Earlier in the game, a vital contribution with the blade by Kohli and Pujara made sure India get 223 runs on the board in the first innings. As South African pacers were on the money and Rabada led the attack with his four-fer. It was the same story for the hosts when they came out to bat, as Keegan Petersen showed composure in the middle and made sure to help his side to get to 210 runs before India bundled them out and had a small lead in hand coming into the third innings.

Best teams fight till the very end, they say. But the body language of India was really low after they came out to field post the Lunch break. Also, surprisingly Kohli went with a combination of Ashwin and Yadav, and South African batters made sure to waste no time and took full advantage of it. Indians started the morning session really well. Their bowlers asked a lot of questions but the batters, had a rub of green, and India could only take a single wicket in the morning session through Lord Shardul Thakur. This wicket gave the visitors a glimmer of hope but South Africa were up to the task and took the game away from India comfortably.

What a revelation Keegan Petersen has been for South Africa. He has been exceptional in this series and that too against a strong bowling attack. In the morning session, Petersen came out with Rassie van der Dussen and saw off the first hour of the session quite comfortably and racked up good amount of runs after Petersen was dropped by Pujara in the slips. But Petersen yet again missed out on his Test century and holed out at 82. Later, Bavuma came to the crease and batted with great composure along with Rassie van der Dussen and remained unscathed till Lunch. After the break, South Africa wasted no time and scored runs at a brisk rate and chased the target within 45 minutes to seal the series.

South Africa take a 2-1 lead and win this Test series. What a turnaround this has been for the Proteas. Winning two back-to-back games to make the series theirs, who would've thought? The South African dressing room are up and celebrating. This Test had everything, drama, emotions, comebacks. Both the teams gave their all but, in the end, the hosts maintain their domination at home and India would be disappointed as they were not able to snatch the series even after winning the first Test match. Let's not forget about the World Test Championship point table. South Africa take the fourth spot after this victory and India slip down a spot and are now 5th on the point table.

FOUR! There comes the winning runs! Loopy ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma sits down on one knee, reaches out for it. He brings out the sweep and sends the ball to deep square leg. Each and every Indian player were stationed inside the ring and thus, the ball easily rolls away to the fence. Temba Bavuma gets the winning runs for his team. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 7 WICKETS AND WIN THE SERIES 2-1!

FIVE RUNS! Oh, dear! A loopy ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen taps it to point and scampers through to the other end. Umesh Yadav collects the ball and has a shy at the keepers end. The ball is away from the wickets and there is no out there to stop the ball. The races away towards the boundary for four overthrows. Really sloppy from India!
Flatter, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen, on back foot, blocks it out.
Length delivery, outside off. Temba Bavuma blocks it out.

More runs! A fuller ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leans and drives it past mid off. Shardul Thakur, there dives to his left and tries to stop it, but fails to do so. Three runs taken at the end.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen offers to shot on that.
Fuller length, around middle. Rassie van der Dussen drives and finds Ravichandran Ashwin at mid on.
Length ball, around the pads. Rassie van der Dussen tucks it to mid-wicket. He wants a single there but decides against it at the end.
Very full this time, around middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off. Bavuma blocks it out.
Loopy ball, around off. Temba Bavuma blocks it out solidly.
BEATEN! A shorter ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma hangs back and looks to block this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Top-shot! A loopy ball, around off. Temba Bavuma sweeps this towards deep square leg for a boundary. That brings up the 200 for South Africa! They are just 12 away.
Touch fuller, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it towards deep cover for a single.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Temba Bavuma, on back foot, pushes it back to the bowler. It was in the air, but falls short of Umesh Yadav.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Temba Bavuma, drives it to the fielder at cover.
Outside off, on a length. Temba Bavuma hangs back and pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Another length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma tries to push it through cover, but gets an inside edge past mid-wicket for two runs. South Africa 17 runs away now.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Temba Bavuma pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
A length ball, around off. Temba Bavuma leans and blocks it out.
Full and on leg. Bavuma flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on leg. Bavuma prods and defends it out.
On middle, blocked out.
On off, driven to extra cover for a single.
Flighted, full and on leg. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it aerially towards short leg, but it hit the fielder on his thighs.
Sliding down leg. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
Full and on leg. Rassie van der Dussen defends it out wathcfully. The umpire signals a no ball, as the bowler oversteps.
Two runs! Length ball, just outside off. Bavuma slaps it towards point. The fielder dives to his right to make a half-stop. The batters run a couple. South Africa need 22 more runs to win.
Good length, outside off. Bavuma stays back and defends it to cover.
Length, on middle and leg. Bavuma blocks it out watchfully.
Fuller, on off. Bavuma defends it to mid-wicket off the inner half.

FOUR! Temba Bavuma growing in confidence as the time goes by. This was a lovely shot to watch. Good length, outside off. Temba Bavuma stays on the back foot and punches it through cover-point for a boundary. He moves to 19.
Fuller, on off. Bavuma remains solid in his defence.
Length ball, on off. Bavuma defends it to cover. The umpire signals a no ball, as the bowler oversteps. This extra will hurt India.
Around middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen defends it out to the leg side. Four runs off the over.
Full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out watchfully.
Another single as this is flicked to mid-wicket.

Another single! Down leg, Rassie van der Dussen clips it to mid-wicket for a single. Really surprised with the bowling combination that Kohli has gone with. Everyone would've thought to see Bumrah and Shami steaming in from each end.
Runs are coming easily for the hosts now. Full, on leg. Bavuma clips it towards mid on for a single.
Ashwin comes around the wicket now! Full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen bunts it to cover for a quick single.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. South Africa need 33 runs to seal the series.
Bavuma scores his first run after the break. Full, on middle and leg. Bavuma flicks it to the leg side for a quick single.
Fourth dot in a row! A full-length ball, on off. Bavuma presses forward and blocks it to cover.
Length ball, on top of off. Temba Bavuma defends it out with the full face of the blade.
Length ball, outside off. Bavuma stays back and punches it to cover.
A length ball, on off. Bavuma blocks it out solidly.
Umesh Yadav (5-0-22-0) will bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Rassie van der Dussen connects well this time and gets the first boundary after Lunch. This should ease some pressure for them. Fuller, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen gets on one knee and sweeps it through square leg. Boundary.
Floated, full and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen gets low looks to sweep it away. The ball flies off the top edge towards deep square leg. The batters take two easily.
Full, around off. Rassie van der Dussen gets inside the line and defends it to the leg side.
Full, sliding down leg, Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out watchfully.
Tossed up, full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it to cover.

We are back for the second session of Day 4! Indian players stride out to the middle. Temba Bavuma and Rassie van der Dussen will resume their batting. Ravichandran Ashwin will start with the ball. Here we go...
... Day 4, Session 2 ...

India, on the other hand, have been very disciplined with their bowling. They troubled the South African batters a lot, but could not manage to get an early breakthrough. A dropped catch, reviews going against them, nothing went India's way. Shardul Thakur, did come back and grab the big wicket of Petersen and put some pressure on South Africa. But, have not managed to take another wicket. A tough session for India, but they can look to turn things around after the break. But it won't be an easy task. Will India be able to make history? Or will South Africa continue their domination on home turf? To find out, do join us at 1640 IST (1110 GMT) to see what is coming our way in the second session, which should be the final session of this Test match.

South Africa started off the session brilliantly. Keegan Petersen, once again displayed his class and kept the scoreboard ticking. Rassie van der Dussen too did well and was playing a responsible innings. Although the Indian bowlers did trouble them initially, but the duo did well not to get an outside edge on any of the deliveries. Petersen though got a reprieve off the dropped catch by Pujara at slips and since then, Petersen collected runs watchfully. But he could not get his first Test century and slipped out on 82. Later, Temba Bavuma and Rassie van der Dussen did well to remain unscathed till the end of the first session.

An intense session of Test cricket! South Africa on top here after the morning session. Although it seems easy for South Africa, Indian bowlers are making them fight for each run. In the first hour of the session, the hosts were running away but India came back stronger, and picked up the wicket of the big fish, Keegan Petersen. Since then, it has been a challenge for South Africa to score runs. The hosts still need 41 runs, while India need 7 wickets.
Full and on off, Rassie van der Dussen works it behind square on the leg side for a single. South Africa just need 41 runs now. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Full-length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen strides and defends it out.
Outside off, Rassie van der Dussen defends it to the off side.
Fuller and around off, Rassie van der Dussen drives it to mid off.

Review! Virat Kohli takes it upstairs for an lbw review. The UltraEdge confirms no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows it is umpire's call on the ball hitting the wickets. India do not lose a review here. But Rassie van der Dussen survives. A dagger through the heart for India.

NOT OUT! That looked really close in real time. Good-length ball, on off, coming back in. Rassie van der Dussen presses forward and looks to work it on the leg side but misses. He gets hit on the front pad. Shardul Thakur is very confident and appeals for an lbw but Marnus Erasmus says no. Virat Kohli decides to challenge the umpire. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching outside off, the impact was in line and it is umpire's call on wickets hitting. When it's not your day, it's not your day. India retain their review but that will certainly not help their cause. Rassie van der Dussen survives.
Wide of off, left alone by RVD.
Full, on middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Flatter, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen looks to flick but misses.
On the pads, Temba Bavuma goes back and works it to square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, Temba Bavuma looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Loopy ball, on off. Temba Bavuma preeses forward to block.
Tossed up, on off. Temba Bavuma defends it to the off side.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack now.
Similar line and length, Rassie van der Dussen offers no shot.
On a good length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen shoulders arms.
Length ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma plays it nicely to wide of mid on for a single.
A quick run! Fuller on off. Rassie van der Dussen works it to square leg for a quick single.
Angling in from wide of the crease, Rassie van der Dussen nudges it to mid-wicket.

On a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to defend. The ball goes off the inside edge, hits him on the pads and rolls back to the keeper. Rassie van der Dussen needs to be a little careful here.

FOUR! That previous boundary has boosted his confidence. Length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma leans onto it and drives it aerially through covers. The ball races away to the fence. Nice timing on that one. A very calm and composed shot.
Short of a length, outside off. Left alone by Bavuma.
Back of a length, on middle. Temba Bavuma stands on his toes and blocks it out from the crease.
FOUR! Shot! A boundary after the 44th over. Short of a length, on off. Temba Bavuma hops and punches it through covers for a boundary. Just 50 needed now!
Is that a run out? The replays show Rassie van der Dussen had his bat grounded when the bails were coming off. It is not out.

NOT OUT! On a length, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen clips it to mid-wicket. He was out of his crease and the fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The batters now take a single off overthrows. The umpires want to check if Rassie van der Dussen was inside the crease and the replay suggests, he was.

Good-length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen shoulders arms. South Africa are taking their own time to score the remaining runs. They know they are on the verge of winning this series and they don't want to give anything away. They have scored just 2 runs in the last seven overs.
Jasprit Bumrah (16-5-45-1) is back into the attack.
Length ball, on off. Temba Bavuma defends it with a dead bat.
On a good length, nipping in from outside off. Temba Bavuma lets it sail through.
Touch fuller, outside off, Temba Bavuma covers the line and pushes it to the off side.
Fuller, on the pads. Flicked to short mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off. Temba Bavuma shoulders arms.
Short of a length, on off. Temba Bavuma defends it towards covers.
On a length, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it towards square leg.
Shorter ball this time, around middle and leg. Temba Bavuma taps it to short leg and scampers through to the other end.
Full-length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma pushes it towards cover. No run taken.
Back of a length this time, on middle. Temba Bavuma gets on his toes and blocks it out.
Another full ball, around middle this time. Temba Bavuma drags it to the fielder at mid on this time.
Shami serves a fuller length ball, around off. Temba Bavuma pushes it towards mid off.
Thakur ends the over with a full-length ball, around off. Rassie van der Dussen with a solid front foot defense.
Full-length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it solidly.
Full again, on the pads. Temba Bavuma flicks it towards mid on and takes a single. He gets off the mark with that.
Touch fuller, outside off. Temba Bavuma presses forward and blocks it out.
A length ball, outside off. Temba Bavuma shoulders his arms at it.
Good-length delivery, around the off pole. Temba Bavuma leans and blocks it out.
A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen offers no shot. Another maiden for Shami!

BEATEN! A ripper from Shami! A length ball, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen, on back foot, looks to defend that but gets beaten on the outside edge. There have been no runs scored off the last 17 balls now.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen taps it towards mid-wicket.
Very full again, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen prods and blocks it out watchfully.
Another fuller length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it with the full face of his bat.
On a full-length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leans and defends it out.
Outside off, fuller. Temba Bavuma blocks it out towards cover.
Sharp swing for Thakur! A length ball, this one nipping back in sharply from outside off. Temba Bavuma lets that go through.
Back of a length, outside off. Temba Bavuma offers no shot on that.
An outswinger, outside off, on a length. Temba Bavuma leaves it alone.
Temba Bavuma is the new man in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! It is Lord Shardul Thakur who strikes and breaks the partnership. A superb innings comes to an end. A length ball, around off. Keegan Petersen, hangs back and gets cramped for room. He was looking to chop this but gets an inside edge back on the stumps. Shardul Thakur opens the door for India here. Keegan Petersen receives a standing ovation as he walks back. Is this the final twist in this Test match?
Full length, around off. Keegan Petersen pushes it back towards mid off.
Length ball, outside off, some late away swing this time. Rassie van der Dussen looks to defend that away from his body but gets beaten. A maiden over for Shami.
On a length, shaping it onto the pads. Rassie van der Dussen manages to get an outside edge to cover. No run there.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
Very full again, on middle. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it out.
Fuller this time, swinging it in. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it gently towards mid off.
BEATEN! A peach of a delivery! Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to have a poke at it, but gets beaten on the outside edge.

A single to end the over! Fuller, outswinger, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to covers and scampers through for a quick single. He will retain the strike. Thakur should make the batsman play at the ball. Bowling wide outside off won't put any pressure on the Proteas with the position they are in at this moment.
Thakur goes wide again and Rassie van der Dussen shoulders his arms at it.
On a length, outside off, nipping away. Rassie van der Dussen has no stroke to offer yet again.
Thakur continues to bowl it outside off. Rassie van der Dussen is not interested in playing that.
Back of a length, outside off, shaping away a hint. Rassie van der Dussen shuffles across and leaves it alone.
Good length, wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone for the keeper.
Shardul Thakur (5-1-17-0) is back on!
Good length, on off. Keegan Petersen defends it out solidly. South Africa need more 58 runs to win.
Fuller, on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it to cover. He wanted a single and he was down the pitch but was sent back. An overthrow lets the batter to cross ends.
Good length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it back to the bowler.
Short ball, outside off. Petersen goes on his toes and cuts it through point for a single. He moves to 82. He is surely eyeing his first ton of his Test career here.

FOUR! A fortunate one for Petersen. This boundary brings up 150 for the hosts and also the stand moves to 51. A length ball, outside off. Petersen hangs his blade out and gets an outside edge. The ball goes towards third man for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Keegan Petersen blocks it back to the bowler.

DRINKS! South Africa are cruising away here. They are just 64 runs away now. They have surely been on top in the first hour of the day. Cheteshwar Pujara will be gutted with himself after dropping a sitter, it could prove to be a costly one. Still, a few quick wickets in the next hour, India could be back in the game, but still a touch task from here on for the visitors. Also, Mohammed Shami (11-1-34-1) is back into the attack.
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen shoulders his arms at it.
Fuller, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Good length, on off, nips in off the deck. Rassie van der Dussen looks to defend it out but gets rapped above his pads.
Nicely placed! Back of a length, outside off. Petersen punches it through backward point. The batters run three easily.
A length ball, on top of off. Petersen stays inside his crease and defends it out watchfully.
A dot to start with! Full-length ball, on middle and leg. Petersen defends it to mid on.
Fuller, on off. Rassie van der Dussen strides and defends it out solidly. Another good over for the hosts, 7 runs off it.
Full-length ball, on off. Petersen defends it to cover for a quick single. The stand moves to 44. This is what South Africa wanted, a solid stand to put them in the driving seat.
Two more! Full, on the pads. Petersen flicks it to the pocket at mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Keegan Petersen is motoring along really well here. This is a glorious shot. Full-length ball, outside off. Petersen creams it through covers for a boundary. He moves into 70s now.
Length ball, on off. Petersen defends it out solidly.
BEAUTY! Good-length ball, in the corridor of uncertainty. This one flies off the deck. Keegan Petersen shuffles across and looks to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.

FOUR! Great timing! Fuller, on the pads. Rassie van der Dussen flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Runs are coming in thick and fast for the hosts now. A catch dropped by India and South Africa making sure to make the most of it.
Three runs now! Petersen moves to 67. This is full and on leg. Petersen clips it past mid on. The batters take three before the fielder cuts it out.
Fuller, on off. Petersen presses forward and defends it out solidly.
Full length, on off. Petersen pushes it out.

A loud appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested! A full-length ball, on middle, the ball holds its line. Petersen looks to defend it out but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Going over the wickets.
Full-length ball, outside off. Petersen looks to drive it away but gets it to mid-wicket off the inner half. The batters run two easily.
Length ball, outside off. Left alone.
Gets dropped and now he gets more three runs! Length ball, on middle and leg. Keegan Petersen whips it past mid-wicket for three runs.

DROPPED! Oh boy, how can you drop a dolly? These are the chances India has got to take. On a good length, on off, shaping away. Keegan Petersen looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge and flies straight into the hands of first slip but Cheteshwar Pujara makes a full mess off it. Jasprit Bumrah can't believe that.
Wide of off, Keegan Petersen has no trouble in leaving that one alone.
Fuller in length, on off. Keegan Petersen squeezes it out to mid on.
Length ball, on off. Keegan Petersen prods and defends it back to the bowler.
Outside off, on a length. Left alone.
Good-length ball again, outside off, shaping away. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
On a good length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen shoulders arms.
Short of a length again, outside off. Keegan Petersen cuts the ball neatly to deep point for one.

FOUR! This time Keegan Petersen offers a shot and bags a boundary. Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen latches onto it. He slashes it through covers. The cover fielder gives it a chase but the ball wins the race. A boundary. South Africa need 87 runs now.
Well outside off, shaping further away. Keegan Petersen offers no shot.
Umesh Yadav (2-0-5-0) is brought back into the attack.
Length ball, on middle. Keegan Petersen shuffles across and flicks it to fine leg for a single.
On a good length, on off. Keegan Petersen knocks it back to the bowler.
JAFFA! On a good length, around off, shaping away from the batter. Keegan Petersen is forced to draw forward and looks to defend. The ball whistles past the outside edge there.
Back of a length, on off. Keegan Petersen stands on his toes and blocks it out.
Good-length ball, outside off. Left alone

Length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen looks to defend. The ball beats the outside edge and carries through to the keeper. A lot of balls have gone past the outside edge so far but none have found the edge. India in desperate search of wickets here.
Fuller, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen shoulders arms. Back-to-back maidens for India!
On a good length, angling in, on off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it out.
Some late swing there! Good-length ball, outside off, shapes away late. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
On a good length, outside off, nipping away. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it untouched.
On off, Rassie van der Dussen pushes it towards covers.

Review! India have reviewed a caught behind decision. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge indicates no bat involved but shows a spike as the batsman had hit the bat on the ground. A tough decision, but the on-field call stands and India lose a review. Virat Kohli is not happy, this was really close. There was a second spike on the replay which the TV umpire concludes to be off the ground as well and not the blade. But the Indian players think otherwise. Another controversy regarding a review in this Test match. There is so much at stake here, the players are not shy of showing their emotions here.

The first session is set to begin. Indian players stride out to the middle. Followed by Keegan Petersen and Rassie van der Dussen, the new man in at number 4, who walk out to bat for the Proteas. Jasprit Bumrah to complete his over. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar is near the deck. He says, the pitch has got down a little bit. There is a spot near the 8m mark, but when the ball comes around the 6m area, there is something on offer for the bowlers. It should be an interesting day of cricket.

South Africa on the other hand, were sensational and ruled Day 3. First, their pacers produced a lethal spell and bundled out India for 198. It was Lungi Ngidi who worked his magic in the second session and bagged three wickets. Jansen was the pick of the bowler with four wickets, while Rabada took 3 scalps. Chasing 212 , the hosts lost Aiden Markam for just 16 while Dean Elgar departed at the stroke of Stumps. With Keegan Petersen unbeaten on 48 and with 8 wickets in hand, the home side will fancy their chances for the win which will also seal the series for them. But a couple of early wickets in today's first session and things could turn around pretty quickly, you never know. An enthralling day of Test cricket awaits.

The moving day for India didn't turn out to be a great one as India were bowled out for 198, but the day turned out to be a great one for Rishabh Pant as out of those 198, 100 were scored by him. He became the first Asian wicketkeeper to notch up a ton on the South African soil and thanks to his ton, India set up a target of 212 runs. Once again, it was Shami and Bumrah who struck in the final session on Day 3 and the Indians would know that a wicket or two can change the trajectory of the game.

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 4 and what should be the final day of the third and the last Test between India and South Africa. The equation is pretty simple for both teams. South Africa need 111 runs while India need 8 wickets to win their first Test series in South Africa. Let's see how the day pans out and which team wins the series.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

We cannot emphasize the importance of the first session on Day 4. Whichever team comes out on top before Lunch on Day 4 will have a big advantage. If India can get another couple of quick wickets, they will sense their first-ever Test series win in South Africa. But, if the next pair for South Africa can put up a 50-plus stand then the hosts will have a big advantage in the chase. It has been a Test in which not a single moment has been dull and Day 4 promises to be no different. Do join us for the same at 1400 IST (0830 GMT) for the first ball and also for the buildup which begins earlier. Till then, take care and goodbye!

We have witnessed so many comebacks in this Test match by both the sides and right at the stroke of Stumps, Bumrah puts his hand up and gets his side back in the equation after a prized scalp of Elgar. India started brilliantly and it was Shami who drew the first blood. India were not happy after a lbw decision went against them, after South Africa took the review and must have lost some concentration post that, which led to leaking a few extra runs and India won't be happy about it. India need more 8 wickets to mark a historic win in South Africa. Also, lets keep in mind, only thrice a team has chased down a target above 200 runs in Cape Town.

A really good session for the hosts until the wicket of their skipper. South Africa came out to bat with the right intention to chase down a target of 212 runs. Markram was the aggressor while Elgar was being watchful initially. Although, Markram went chasing for a few deliveries outside off and it costed him his wicket. Petersen joined Elgar in the middle, the runs came in at a slow rate initially. But Elgar made sure to make the most of his reprieve and both the batters scored runs at a brisk rate and 100 was up for the hosts in no time. But in the end, Elgar lost his wicket at the stroke of Stumps and that would hurt South Africa a lot.

What a day! What a day of Test cricket! Things are still neck and neck between these two sides and one hour of a dominant display by either side could put them well on top. The game has been dominated by pacers and Day 3 was no different. 10 wickets fell and we have a cracking finish coming up in the next two days.

Review! India have reviewed a caught behind decision. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge confirms there was bat involved in that. The decision needs to be overturned. A successful review for India! Dean Elgar walks back to the hut.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Virat Kohli takes the review and this time Elgar walks back to the pavilion. A full-length ball, down leg. Elgar stays back and looks to flick it away but gets the thinnest of outside-edges on it. Rishabh Pant dives to his right and take a low catch. Bumrah and company appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Kohli is certain Elgar has got some bat on it and takes the review. Big spike of UltraEdge and Elgar has to walk back. Also, THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 3.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Jasprit Bumrah
